did: Second copy is installing - I built and packaged the run kit and wrote the run sheet. This is the first time the loop can close since D3.

HOST.ini/GUEST.ini generated from the maintained ref\\AC4Coop\\AC4Coop.ini (so nothing documented is lost) with only these overrides: EntityHost=1/0, EntitySync=1, SyncEnemiesOnly=1, KrLog=1, StageLog=1, KillTrace=1, DisableSpawns=0 (was 1 - an empty world cannot test an enemy lane), PeerPort=47801, PeerIP placeholder.
run sheet ops/RUN-2026-10-31-two-machine.md, ordered by information value: A link+puppet (empty world, 10 min) -> B G6 does the host classify soldiers live (15 min) -> C G10 do guards see the guest (15 min) -> D G9 kills (15) -> E G7/G8 binding (10). Each has a PASS line and an explicit stop rule.
TASKBOARD T16 updated from blocked to UNBLOCKED with the kit hash.
note for the two runs: DisableSpawns stays 0 for B/C/D/E; set it to 1 only for run A, on BOTH machines, and restart both games.
